situation: I do digital pet and people portraits. Someone named Maya DMed 'hi how much for a portrait?' and nothing else.
reply: Hi Maya! A digital portrait of one person or pet is $85, and each extra one is $30. Turnaround is about 10 days, with one round of edits included. Who's it for?
note: Price in the first line, the extra she'll want next, and one question that moves toward a booking.

situation: 我在小红书卖手作耳环，有人私信："在吗？这个珍珠耳环还有吗"
reply: 在的！这款珍珠耳环还剩最后两对，耳针是925银的，耳朵敏感也能戴。需要的话我帮你留到明晚8点，直接拍就行～
note: 对方话少，回复也短：先回答有没有，再给一个她会关心的细节和一个下一步。

situation: Someone DMed asking the price of my handmade ceramic mugs. I said $38 and they replied 'lol $38 for a mug? Target has them for $5'.
reply: Totally fair, they're not for everyone. $38 is the price for these, and no hard feelings either way. Thanks for asking!
note: Don't defend the number. If they keep arguing or get insulting, stop replying.

situation: I run a mobile dog grooming van. Someone just DMed 'hey r u free this sat? golden retriever, pretty matted'
reply: Hey! Yes, I've got 9am or 1pm this Saturday, the 3rd. A full groom for a golden is $110, and heavy matting can add up to $20, which I'll confirm when I see the coat. Want the 9am or the 1pm?
note: Two exact slots, the matting cost flagged up front so there's no surprise, and one easy question.

situation: Hago tortas por encargo en Montevideo. Me escribió Valentina por Instagram: '¿hacés tortas para 40 personas? Es para el sábado 10 de octubre, tema Frozen'.
reply: ¡Hola Valentina! Sí, tengo lugar para el sábado 10. Una torta temática de Frozen para 40 personas sale $3.800 e incluye la decoración y el cartel con el nombre. Para reservar la fecha pido una seña de $1.500; ¿te paso los datos para transferir?
note: Custom order with a date: confirm availability and price first, then make the deposit the single next step.

situation: 我在小红书卖手工皮具，一个长钱包380元。有人私信：'能便宜点吗？买两个呢'
reply: 单个就是380，价格不打折哈。买两个的话送两个同色钥匙扣，顺丰包邮，一般3天到。你想要什么颜色？我拍现货给你看。
note: 先答价格不绕弯，不降价但给一个买两个的实在好处，最后一个问题推进下单。

situation: I'm a florist. On Sunday a bride, Hannah, asked on WhatsApp about flowers for her wedding on October 17. I quoted $1,450 for her bouquet, 4 bridesmaid posies and 20 table centrepieces. Blue ticks, no reply. That's my last free Saturday in October.
reply: Hi Hannah, just checking whether you'd like me to hold Saturday 17 October for your flowers. It's my last free Saturday that month, so I can keep it for you until Friday. Totally fine if you've gone another way.
note: One follow-up about 48 hours after the price, with a true reason to reply and an easy no. If nothing comes back, leave it.

situation: 我在成都开陶艺工作室，周末有体验课。有人在小红书私信：'你们的体验课是怎么上的？零基础可以吗'
reply: 可以的，体验课就是给零基础准备的！每周六下午2点到5点，298元一位，含材料和烧制，老师手把手带你拉坯，做好的杯子或碗三周后来店里取，或者包邮寄给你。每场最多6个人。这周六10月3号还剩2个位置，要帮你留一个吗？
note: 先答'可以'，再补上时间、价格和她会想知道的取件方式，最后只问一个问题推进报名。

situation: I make hand-poured soy candles and sell them on Instagram for $32 each. A gift shop owner in Portland, Jenna, just DMed 'hi! do you do wholesale? love the fig one'.
reply: Hi Jenna! Yes, wholesale is $16 a candle, with a 24-candle minimum that you can mix across scents. Orders ship within a week, and the fig one is our bestseller, so it's a good pick. Want me to send over the wholesale sheet with all 9 scents?
note: Wholesale inquiry: answer with the price and minimum first, add the one fact a shop owner needs next, then one easy next step.

situation: I sell linen aprons on Instagram. Someone DMed 'hi! is the rust apron back in stock? it's for my mom's bday on oct 10'. The rust restock doesn't arrive until Oct 16.
reply: Hi! The rust one is back on Oct 16, so it won't make the 10th, sorry. The terracotta is in stock, a shade lighter, and orders by Monday Oct 5 arrive in time. Want a photo of the two side by side?
note: Answer first even when it's a no, then the nearest option that meets their real deadline, and one easy question.

situation: I sell custom embroidered baby blankets on Instagram for $65. A customer, Tara, DMed asking if I can do one with Bluey on it and her nephew's name, Theo. I don't stitch licensed characters.
reply: Hi Tara! I can't stitch Bluey, since it's a licensed character I don't have permission to use, but I can do a little blue heeler pup in a similar spirit with Theo's name, same $65. It takes about 8 days to make plus 3 for shipping. Want me to send you a quick sketch first?
note: When the answer is no, still answer first, then offer the closest thing you can legally make and one easy next step.

situation: Vendo luminárias de cerâmica feitas à mão pelo Instagram, aqui em Belo Horizonte, a R$ 290 cada. A Inês, de Lisboa, mandou DM: "Olá! Enviam para Portugal?"
reply: Olá, Inês! Enviamos, sim. O frete para Portugal sai R$ 180 por luminária, com rastreio, e chega em 15 a 25 dias úteis. Pode haver imposto de importação cobrado na entrega, então vale confirmar com os CTT. Quer que eu te mande o link com o valor total já calculado?
note: Pedido internacional: sim ou não na primeira linha, depois frete e prazo, e o aviso sobre taxas para não haver surpresa.

situation: 我在朋友圈和小红书卖自己设计的连衣裙，一条459元。有人私信：“不合适能退吗？我在S和M之间，怕买错。”
reply: 可以的，收到7天内没穿过、吊牌还在，退或换码都行，换码的来回运费我出。你方便说下身高体重和平时穿的码吗？我帮你挑一个更稳的。
note: 先答能不能退，再把换码运费这个顾虑提前解决，最后只问一个问题帮她选码。

situation: 我在小红书卖手工冷制皂，燕麦款58元一块。有个宝妈私信：“宝宝8个月，有湿疹，这个能给他用吗？”
reply: 这个我没法替医生打包票，湿疹宝宝能不能用，最好先问问给他看湿疹的医生。燕麦款的成分是橄榄油、椰子油、燕麦粉和乳木果油，无香精无色素，完整成分表可以直接拿给医生看。医生说可以的话，我这边有20克的小样，12元，先少量试一下更放心。要我把成分表发给你吗？
note: 涉及宝宝皮肤健康，不做功效承诺：先给诚实的答案，再给成分和小样，让她和医生决定。

situation: I'm a personal trainer. A guy named Ollie DMed me on Instagram last Friday: 'hey how much for 1 on 1 sessions? total beginner'. I only just saw it today, five days later.
reply: Hi Ollie, sorry for the slow reply, your message got buried. One-to-one sessions are $70 an hour, or $600 for a pack of ten, and the first one starts with a relaxed movement check, so total beginner is exactly right. I've got Friday at 7am or Saturday at 9am this week, would either suit you?
note: Replying days late: one line of ownership, then the answer straight away, so the apology doesn't become the message.

situation: 我在小红书卖手工香薰蜡烛，一只128元。有个博主私信：“我有2万粉丝，可以免费寄一套给我吗？我发笔记帮你推广。”我目前不做免费置换，但可以给博主七折。
reply: 你好，谢谢喜欢！我们目前不做免费寄送，不过博主可以七折购买，一只128元折后89.6元，香型随便挑。要我把现在有货的香型发给你看看吗？
note: 免费置换的请求也先给答案：不做，但给一个真实的选项，不评价对方粉丝多少。

situation: I'm a hairdresser working from a home salon. Chloe DMed 'how much for balayage? shoulder length, currently box dyed dark brown'. My balayage is $180 for shoulder length, box dye usually needs a colour-removal step first for $60, and I do free 15-minute consults to check the hair.
reply: Hi Chloe! Balayage on shoulder-length hair is $180. With box dye you'll most likely need a colour-removal step first, which is $60, so plan on about $240 in total. I can confirm the exact price at a free 15-minute consult; want me to find you a time this week?
note: When the price depends on the hair, still give the number: the base, the likely extra, the likely total, then the step that pins it down.

situation: I sell restored vintage road bikes on Instagram, sold in person in Portland for cash or bank transfer on collection. Someone DMed about a 1984 steel road bike listed at $420: 'I'll pay $500 if you hold it, I'll mail a cheque and my mover will collect'. I hold bikes only with a $50 deposit by bank transfer.
reply: Hi! It's still available at $420. I only sell in person here in Portland, paid by cash or bank transfer at collection, so I can't take a cheque or anything over the price. I can hold it for you with a $50 deposit by bank transfer. When would you like to come and see it?
note: Overpayment plus a posted cheque plus a third-party collector is a common scam pattern: stick to your terms and never send money back.

situation: Instagramで革小物を販売しています。キーケース（4,800円）について佐藤さんからDM：「名入れってできますか？10月9日の金曜日までに欲しいです」。名入れは＋800円でローマ字8文字まで、注文から発送まで5営業日、佐藤さんは東京在住とのことで発送の翌日に届きます。
reply: 佐藤さん、はい、名入れできます！キーケースへの刻印は＋800円で、ローマ字8文字までです。発送まで5営業日かかるので、明日10月1日（木）中にご注文いただければ9日（金）にお届けできます。入れたい文字を教えていただければ、ご注文リンクをお送りしますね。
note: 締め切りから逆算した注文日を先に伝えると、急かさずに次の一歩が明確になる。

situation: I make custom cookie gift boxes. Priya ordered 30 boxes for her team from me last December, and today she DMed on Instagram: 'hi again!! can we do the same as last year but 45 boxes, delivered Dec 11?' Dec 11 is free, my price is now $24 a box (it was $22), and I need orders confirmed by Nov 20.
reply: Hi Priya, lovely to hear from you again! Yes, December 11 works, and 45 boxes are $24 each this year, so $1,080 in total. Same designs as last year, or would you like a festive twist? Once you confirm by November 20, the date is yours.
note: A returning customer gets the new price stated plainly in the first answer, not discovered at checkout.

situation: I run a pottery studio in a converted shop. Grace DMed: 'is your studio wheelchair accessible? want to book my mum's birthday class on oct 17'. There's one small step at the door and we have a portable ramp, one wheel table fits a wheelchair, but the toilet is up a flight of stairs; the 2pm class that Saturday still has space.
reply: Hi Grace, mostly yes: there's one small step at the door and we have a portable ramp for it, and one of our wheel tables fits a wheelchair. The one thing that isn't accessible is the toilet, which is up a flight of stairs. The 2pm class on Saturday 17 October has space; shall I hold two spots with the accessible table for your mum?
note: Name the one thing that isn't accessible up front, so they decide now rather than discover it on the day.
